description.en: Cranial-to-caudal myotomy starting ≥2 cm below the mucosotomy site, extended 2–3 cm distal to the GEJ, tailored short vs long by disease type.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for myotomy technique but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs myotomy technique independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches myotomy technique to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of the source-canonical ESGE POEM 2025 Part II recommendations into trainee-assessable units. The POEM curriculum enumerates recommendations and the PPAT scores procedures; this competency frame is Evideris's design for portfolio-level tracking.
